#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    int length;
    std::cin >> length;
    std::cin.ignore();
    std::string str;
    std::getline(std::cin, str);

    int maxLength = 0;
    int countLength = 0;
    int countWord = 0;
    int checker = 0;
    int checkerInside = 0;
    bool isInWordOut = false;
    bool isInWordIn = false;
    bool isInside = false;

    int index = 0;
    while (index < length) {
        char c = str[index];
        if (c == '(') {
            isInside = true;
            checkerInside++;
            if (maxLength < countLength)
                maxLength = countLength;
            countLength = 0;
            isInWordOut = false;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            isInside = false;
            checkerInside = 0;
            if (checker > 0) {
                countWord++;
                checker = 0;
            }
        } else {
            if (checkerInside > 0)
                isInside = true;
        }

        if (c != ')' && c != '(') {
            if (!isInside) {
                if (c == '_') {
                    if (maxLength < countLength)
                        maxLength = countLength;
                    countLength = 0;
                    isInWordOut = false;
                } else {
                    isInWordOut = true;
                }
                if (isInWordOut)
                    countLength++;
            } else {
                isInWordOut = false;
                if (c == '_') {
                    if (checker > 0)
                        countWord++;
                    checker = 0;
                    isInWordIn = false;
                } else {
                    isInWordIn = true;
                }
                if (isInWordIn)
                    checker++;
            }
        }

        index++;
    }

    if (maxLength < countLength)
        maxLength = countLength;

    std::cout << maxLength << " " << countWord << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
